what: coupon C4: FEA of the coupon at 1 kN, the load at which each criterion reaches 1

layer_check_at_1kn.shear_basis: interlayer shear allowable assumed to be strength_z / sqrt(3), the ratio von Mises gives an isotropic solid: no filament data sheet gives one; pass strength_shear from a coupon
layer_check_at_1kn.assumptions: the stress of the linear, isotropic solve (one modulus), resolved on the layer plane at every element corner; bond: the opening stress across the layers and the shear along them, in quadratic interaction, against the across-layer and interlayer shear allowables (compression across the layers left out); bulk: von Mises against the in-plane allowable. A screening check for a transversely isotropic print, not a qualification: an anisotropic part can carry its load differently, and walls, seams and infill are not modelled. Test a printed part
